intro: I'm Sachin Raj. I build robotic systems and validate them — the same person doing both, on purpose.

My background is mechanical engineering. I've spent years in regulated environments where data pipelines drive high-stakes decisions — genomic diagnostics, clinical data quality, sequencer output moving through bioinformatics workflows where a silent error has consequences. That work taught me how to prove a system is correct: not just that it runs, but that it produces what it claims to produce, reproducibly, with documentation that holds up to scrutiny.
I'm now applying that same validation discipline to physical systems — robotics, hydraulic arms, sensor pipelines. The methodology transfers. The stakes change.

contact.note: Open to research collaboration, technical questions about the tools or papers, and conversations with engineers working on robotic systems and validation methodology.
